agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  BUILDING DIVISION

  CONSTRUCTION APPEALS BOARD MEETING AGENDA
September 15, 2026, 5:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Appellate hearing of Notice and Order to Vacate and Repair Due to
  Unsafe Conditions, continued from September 1, 2026.
  A. Building Official Comments
  B. Appellant Comments
  C. Public Comments
  D. Board Decision

  #4 Hearing Documents

5.  Public Comments.  Anyone wishing to address the Construction
  Appeals Board on any matter within its jurisdiction that is not
  otherwise addressed on the agenda may do so at this time.

6.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Building Safety Division at (310) 412-5294, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5294."

In the event that the Construction Appeals Board meeting of September
15, 2026, is not held, or is concluded prior to the agenda item(s) being
considered, the agenda item(s) will automatically be continued to the
next Construction Appeals Board meeting.

  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
